settings.purpose: which model answers, placed at install from the text-reasoning binding, so that changing it is a setting and not a new version; the package names none and refuses to call a model when it is empty. A name starting google-vertex-anthropic/ is Claude on Google Vertex AI and the credential is then where to call, written <project>/<location>; a bare name is a Gemini model at Google and the credential is its key

directories.purpose: the request, the architecture, the bindings, the record and its checks for each job
